name: CSV Exporter
summary: This EA periodically exports candle close prices to a CSV file at a user-defined interval. It reads a specified number of historical bars and writes their close prices to a symbol-and-period-named CSV file. It does not place any trades or analyze market conditions for trading decisions.
summary_zh: 该EA按用户设定的时间间隔，周期性地将K线收盘价导出至CSV文件。它读取指定数量的历史K线，并将收盘价写入以品种和周期命名的CSV文件中。该EA不进行任何交易操作，也不为交易决策分析市场条件。
strategy_analysis: 该EA没有任何交易策略概念，它纯粹是一个数据导出工具。入场条件和出场条件均不适用，因为该EA不会开仓或平仓。仓位管理和资金管理也完全不涉及。其核心逻辑是使用CopyRates函数获取指定数量的历史K线数据，然后通过FileWrite将每根K线的收盘价写入CSV文件。更新机制依赖一个简单的定时器，通过比较当前时间与上次写入时间来决定是否触发新的导出操作。第一次执行使用x=1秒的延迟，之后切换为用户设定的UpdateTime间隔。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA has no trading strategy concept whatsoever; it is purely a data export utility. Entry conditions and exit conditions are not applicable since the EA never opens or closes any positions. Position sizing and money management are completely absent as well. Its core logic uses the CopyRates function to retrieve a specified number of historical candle bars, then writes each bar's close price to a CSV file via FileWrite. The update mechanism relies on a simple timer that compares the current time against the last write time to determine whether to trigger a new export cycle. The first execution uses a delay of x=1 second, after which it switches to the user-configured UpdateTime interval.

parameters.name: UpdateTime
parameters.description: EA重新运行并导出数据的间隔时间（秒）
parameters.description_en: EA restart and data export interval (seconds)

parameters.name: CandleCount
parameters.description: 导出的K线数量，将覆盖已有CSV文件中的数据
parameters.description_en: Number of candles to export, overwrites existing CSV data

pros: 实现简单直接，代码逻辑清晰易懂
支持自定义更新间隔和导出K线数量，具有一定灵活性
文件名包含品种和周期信息，便于多品种多周期同时运行时区分
使用FILE_ANSI格式写入，兼容性好，可在多种程序中读取
pros_en: Simple and straightforward implementation with clear logic that is easy to understand
Supports customizable update interval and candle count, offering some flexibility
Filename includes symbol and timeframe info, making it easy to distinguish when running multiple instances
Uses FILE_ANSI format for writing, ensuring good compatibility with various external programs
cons: 仅导出收盘价，缺少开盘价、最高价、最低价、成交量和时间等关键OHLCV数据
使用FILE_WRITE模式会覆盖整个文件，无法增量追加历史数据
缺少文件操作错误检查，FileOpen失败时会导致空指针写入崩溃
CopyRates返回值未做有效性验证，数据不足时可能输出无效内容
注释掉的代码中暗示曾计划导出更多字段但未实现，功能不完整
cons_en: Only exports close prices, missing open, high, low, volume, and timestamp — critical OHLCV data
FILE_WRITE mode overwrites the entire file each cycle, making incremental data accumulation impossible
No error checking on file operations; a failed FileOpen would cause a crash due to invalid handle writes
CopyRates return value is not validated; insufficient data could lead to invalid output content
Commented-out code suggests more fields were planned but never implemented, indicating incomplete functionality
improvements: 增加OHLCV完整数据导出，包括时间、开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价和成交量
添加FileOpen和CopyRates的错误检查，防止无效句柄导致崩溃
增加文件追加模式选项或增量写入逻辑，避免每次覆盖已有数据
improvements_en: Add complete OHLCV data export including time, open, high, low, close, and tick volume fields
Add error checking for FileOpen and CopyRates return values to prevent crashes from invalid handles
Add an append mode option or incremental write logic to avoid overwriting existing data each cycle

risk_points: 无文件操作错误检查，FileOpen失败可能导致无效句柄写入引发终端异常
文件覆盖写入模式可能导致外部程序读取时获取不完整数据
risk_points_en: No file operation error checking; a failed FileOpen could cause writing to an invalid handle and crash the terminal
File overwrite mode may cause external programs to read incomplete or corrupted data during write cycles
